message: Add ACP session notice support (#64606) Implement Zed client support for the draft [ACP Session Notices RFD](https://agentclientprotocol.com/rfds/session-notices), allowing agents to surface operational advisories without turning them into conversation history. - Advertise the v1 notices capability behind the existing ACP beta feature flag - Keep notices in live, session-local state, with independent local dismissal and no persistence, transcript/export entries, protocol acknowledgement, or changes to generation status. - Render dismissible callouts above the composer in a bounded scrolling area. Support info, warning, and error treatments, with a generic presentation for unknown severities and plain-text titles/descriptions. - Provide screen-reader labels, keyboard dismissal with focus restoration, and a single scrolling surface for long descriptions. - Add a shared notice component and designer previews for severity variants, title-only/detailed content, narrow layouts, and overflowing stacks. Open **workspace: open component preview**, then select **Agent → Session Notice**. Release Notes: - N/A
